notes:
I couldn't find underwater basket weaving for toddlers in Halton Hills, or anywhere else. The basket-weaving results were adult workshops, and none were in Halton Hills. The closest real things for a toddler this fall are a water class and a parent-and-tot class, both run by the operators themselves.

- **Town of Halton Hills swim lessons:** This is the nearest thing to "underwater" for a toddler. The town's page lists the Acton fall term and price above. The page I read doesn't give a class day or time for Acton. The town also lists drop-in Parent & Tot lessons for the fall, on Tuesdays or Thursdays from 10:00 a.m., running September 22 to December 29. That listing is cut off, so I haven't confirmed the end time or the location.
- **Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre (36 Armstrong Avenue, Georgetown):** Their page describes a 30-minute class with a parent taking part. It covers a structured warm-up, games, music and circuits. I didn't find a class day, time or price on the page I read. Their page says fall registration opened July 20, so it's worth ringing them at 905-877-4330 for those details.
